title.en: Explore the path beneath the return

intro.en: Select a year to inspect the frozen 400-name NAV. Drawdown uses the highest earlier level in the full source series.
intro.zh: 选择年份，查看400只股票历史净值的回撤。回撤按整段来源序列此前的最高净值计算。

scope.en: 2015–2026 historical illustration. The final year is partial. Portfolio accounting and executable returns remain unverified.
scope.zh: 图中展示2015年至2026年的历史序列，末年样本尚未完整。组合账目与实际成交收益仍待核验。
